item.title: History may not repeat itself, but it often rhymes
item.description: In a world where growth and revenues are almost always prioritised over risk, I think it helps to look back at history and remind ourselves of the follies of humankind. After all, history may not repeat itself, but it often rhymes. I just finished reading 1873 by Liaquat Ahamed, about the Vienna stock market crash that eventually triggered a global financial crisis. I had read 1929 by Andrew Ross Sorkin last year, which explores a similar theme.
